title: POST /stop
description: Terminates the running turn and pauses the agent's queue and goals until resumed. Request body: session, optional actor (default "user"; agents send "agent:<session>") and reason (up to 200 chars). Queue state also travels over SSE (queue-updated). Contract 61 adds the fields below. stop_actor_verified is true only when the Host verified the actor (a Host-issued agent turn identity, or a paired device acting as "user"); otherwise stop_actor is the caller's claim. queue_paused and goals_paused are committed effects read back after the Stop; absent means unknown, as on older Hosts.
